Each close, 19% of settled answers are re-asked under a fresh nonce, and a failed re-ask claws back the original reward. That is 9 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
